name: URY Pending Acknowledgements
query:
SELECT ack.controlled_document AS `Document`, doc.title AS `Title`, ack.revision_no AS `Revision`, ack.user AS `User`, ack.role AS `Role`, ack.branch AS `Branch`, ack.restaurant AS `Restaurant`, ack.acknowledged_on AS `Acknowledged On`
FROM `tabURY Document Acknowledgement` ack
LEFT JOIN `tabURY Controlled Document` doc ON doc.name = ack.controlled_document
WHERE (%(controlled_document)s IS NULL OR ack.controlled_document = %(controlled_document)s)
  AND (%(user)s IS NULL OR ack.user = %(user)s)
  AND (%(branch)s IS NULL OR ack.branch = %(branch)s)
ORDER BY ack.modified DESC
